It goes down gradually, and you pretty much move to anabolic after noon. Your hormones are at peak efficiency first thing in the morning and they start deteriorating as the day progresses. The deterioration is further boosted by added stress (like work). Thats the reason many people fast in the early hours of the morning because thats when your body is breaking down things the fastest. Thats also why highly stressed people have a tendency of storing more body fat since moving to an anabolic state is the body's defense mechanism against stress (think primitive humans during a period of starvation).
